text: TTC’s 404 East York Community Bus, runs from the area of Kingston Road and Main Street to Coxwell Station. Along its route, it serves a variety of popular destinations within the neighbourhood. As a result of a recent route change, TTC is requesting an exemption from a turn prohibition on Kingston road at Glen Manor Drive. This westbound left-turn prohibition is in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, for vehicles on Kingston Road. Transportation Services staff determined that this exemption has minimal impact on traffic operations on Kingston Road and Glen Manor Drive and has no objections to the proposed change.

City Council on March 9, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the westbound left-turn prohibition on Kingston Road and Glen Manor Drive, in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, to be in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, except Toronto Transit Commission vehicles.
